officialJapaneseCatalog.title: 2026-2027 GRAY SNOWBOARDS PERFECT GUIDE (Japanese)
officialJapaneseCatalog.evidence: Official season catalog confirms eight size/width variants, per-size geometry, camber, stance, setback, inserts, edge, base, sidewall color and N/W/T stiffness. It lists Directional Twin, Directional Flex, TripleRadius, Negative and Single Camber. Construction legend identifies STD Core II and size-group-specific fiberglass-ply notation. MSRP is JPY 115,000 before tax / JPY 126,500 tax-inclusive.

officialEnglishCatalog.title: 2026-2027 GRAY SNOWBOARDS PERFECT GUIDE (English)
officialEnglishCatalog.evidence: Season-specific corroboration for product description and per-size table. Prodigy is described as a high-speed directional twin, with X-shaped carbon rovings beneath the wood core and fiberglass layers on both sides.

officialSeasonProduct.evidence: Confirms 26/27 Prodigy identity, slightly stiffer tail flex balance, hybrid sidecut positioning and manufacturer-described use from superpipe/big kickers to high-speed all-mountain riding. Positioning copy is not independent ride-test evidence.

officialSeasonTechnology.evidence: Confirms 26/27 wood-core sandwich construction and describes STD Core II as a paulownia-based core reinforced with hinoki along both sides.

officialJapan.note: Not a verified China-market offer or Chinese retail price.

seedNormalization.note: Currency normalization only; not an observed China-market price. Value score is therefore low confidence.

units.overallLengthMm: Catalog millimeters; the size label is also represented as centimeters in product-level fields.
units.effectiveEdgeMm: Catalog effective edge in millimeters; kept separate from contact length.
units.sidecutRadiusMm: Three printed radii preserved in catalog order; YAML stores the sequence in millimeters as printed.
units.stanceSetbackMm: Catalog setback magnitude in millimeters; its direction/sign convention is not defined in the catalog.
units.stiffnessNWT: Manufacturer N/W/T scale values copied as printed; not mapped to the site's editorial flex or six score dimensions.
units.coreAndFiberglass: Catalog construction legend associates STD Core II and differing fiberglass ply notation with size groups; YAML stores the named core and general fiberglass/carbon construction, while exact ply grouping remains in source notes.

scoringReview.decision: Keep all six scores unchanged. The official catalog establishes intended use and construction, not measured ride performance. Searches found no independent test attributable to a 26/27 production sample. Older Prodigy or Prodigy_Ti ride reports are not treated as same-season evidence. Keep scores explicitly low confidence; value is especially uncertain because CNY 5370 is a converted Japanese MSRP, not a Chinese-market offer.
scoringReview.confidence: low; no same-season independent production-sample ride test found

unverified: No verified Chinese-market retail price, product weight, warranty term, or product-specific independent 26/27 ride test was found.
No explicit image reuse permission was verified; the official image URL remains reference-only.
The catalog's setback values are preserved as magnitudes; direction/sign convention is not documented.

Exact fiberglass ply notation varies by size group and is preserved in sizeRows; the product-level YAML field records the common fiberglass plus X-carbon construction rather than reducing all sizes to one layup.
imageRights: No explicit reuse license verified; retain as a source reference only and do not copy to hosted production assets without permission or original photography.
mappingNotes: All eight catalog variants were compared with YAML sizeSpecs; the listed geometry, stance, setback, camber, edge, base, sidewall and manufacturer stiffness values match.
